text: At its meeting held December 15, 16, and 17, 2021, (Item CA26.3) City Council appointed the following members to the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee for a term of office from December 18, 2021 to November 14, 2022: Cynthia Bell-Clayton Leonard Benoit Nora Boyer Isaac Crosby Chris Lefebvre Christine Luza Saige McMahon Patricia Pettigrew Tristen Schneider Suzanne Stewart In addition, the seat previously held by Regina Hartwick was declared vacant effective October 22, 2021 and was filled as part of this process.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
